messages:
Priya K.: Heads up — following the KiteLabs postmortem, we need to consolidate the remediation items that span Dedicated + On‑Prem peering. There's some overlap with the isolation bug we keep seeing.
Sam H.: Agree. Can you paste the short list? I can grab ownership for networking actions. :+1:
Priya K.: TL;DR from postmortem:
  1) Flaky VPC peering route propagation between our edge and customer firewall (KiteLabs) — sometimes stale / missing routes after peering recon.
  2) On‑prem NAT/firewall constraints causing asymmetric paths and session timeouts.
  3) A recurring isolation bug where tenant traffic hits an old route table during autoscale.
  4) Lack of automated verification after peering updates.
Linh: Noted. For (1) I think we need a retry-with-backoff on our peering update job and a post‑apply verification step.
Marc: For (2) we should document the minimum on‑prem firewall config and add it to the private deployment checklist. Customer kept a weird stateful timeout lower than our expectation.
Priya K.: Proposed owners + TLs:
  - VPC peering propagation & retry logic: Sam H. (owner)
  - Post‑apply verification jobs + alerting: Linh (owner)
  - On‑prem firewall guidance + runbook: Marc / Ops‑Jen (co‑owners)
  - Isolation bug triage (autoscale route table race): Priya (owner)
Sam H.: Ack. I'll create a short RFC for the retry logic and include metrics we can emit. Expected ETA: prototype in 2 sprints, then canary.
Ops-Jen: For the on‑prem doc I'll schedule a 1hr working session with Solutions to capture the vendor variance. Ops wanted a checklist of these fields: TCP timeout, established session limits, and asymmetric routing guidance.
Linh: For verification, plan is: after any peering change run:
```
# quick verification steps (pseudo)
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=$VPC | jq '.RouteTables'
curl -sL http://edge-health/KiteLabs/peer-check
```
and fail the job if route missing. Add an alert: `peer.propagation.failures > 1` in 15m.
Priya K.: Good. Also adding a requirement: every Dedicated/Private postmortem that has networking impact must include a short test prompt that's runnable by Support (so they can verify customer connectivity without engineering).
Marc: +1. Support runbook snippet example: steps + expected outputs. I'll draft a short template.
Sam H.: Question — do we want a recurring trend analysis for these isolation patterns? If it's repeating across customers, we need a quarterly RCA review and a metric for "isolation incidents per 1k customer changes." 
Priya K.: Yes — add to Roadmap: quarterly isolation trends review, owner: Priya, start: next quarter.
oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-12-KiteLabs marked RESOLVED by Sam H. — postmortem published.
Ops-Jen: Quick action items (from this thread) — I'll create the Jira ticket names here so we can track:
  - RI-PEER-RETRY (owner: Sam H.) — add retry + verification job
  - RI-PEER-VERIFY (owner: Linh) — verification + alerts + test endpoint
  - RI-ONPREM-RUNBOOK (owners: Marc, Ops-Jen) — on‑prem firewall checklist + Support test script
  - RI-AUTOSCALE-ROUTE (owner: Priya K.) — investigate route table binding race during autoscale
Priya K.: Please add rough SLAs for each ticket: prototype / proposal 2 weeks, implementation 4–6 weeks, canary 1 sprint. If any ticket needs >8 weeks escalate to eng leads.
Sam H.: I added RI-PEER-RETRY to Jira with label "postmortem-remediation" and linked the PM. ETA: proposal 2026-04-01 (two weeks).
Linh: Created a minimal verification job branch, putting it behind feature flag. I'll ping when PR is up.
Marc: Drafted runbook template and uploaded to Confluence (link: https://redwood.internal/confluence/RI-ONPREM-RUNBOOK). Feedback welcome.
Priya K.: Great. Final asks before I close this tracking thread:
  - owners confirm tickets exist + ETA (reply with ticket id)
  - Ops to run the Support test prompt on KiteLabs staging once verification job is live
  - Priya to run quarterly trends review (calendar invite will follow)
Sam H.: RI-PEER-RETRY-1234 (ETA 2026-04-01).
Linh: RI-PEER-VERIFY-5678 (PR in progress).
Marc: RI-ONPREM-RUNBOOK-9012 (working session scheduled next Wednesday).
Priya K.: RI-AUTOSCALE-ROUTE-3344 (triage started). I'll close this thread once tickets are green. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
